question: Does prior strong-chorus use by the focal species predict where it reactivates beyond a site's generic tendency to host strong choruses of other species?
population: Physically stable NAAMP matched pairs with at least one eligible prior run in the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum. Focal species are absent from the entire dry route, present in the wet route, and known from the route in prior years.
unit: pair x focal species x physical SiteID with at least one prior sampling opportunity for that SiteID

prior_predictors.own_prior_strong: 1 if the focal species had CallingIndex 2-3 at the SiteID in any eligible run strictly before the earlier focal-pair year.
prior_predictors.generic_other_strong_rate: Across prior runs in which that SiteID was sampled, mean number of other species (excluding the focal species) with CallingIndex 2-3 at the SiteID.

outcomes.wet_strong: 1 if focal species reaches CallingIndex 2-3 at the SiteID in the wet survey.
outcomes.wet_full: 1 if focal species reaches CallingIndex 3 at the SiteID.

primary_design: Restrict to pair x species groups containing both own_prior_strong=1 and 0. Demean outcome, own_prior_strong, generic_other_strong_rate and their rain_contrast interactions within pair x species. Regress demeaned wet_strong on all four demeaned predictors without intercept; cluster covariance by State x RouteNumber.
primary_prediction: Coefficient on own_prior_strong remains >0 with complete 95% CI >0 after generic site chorus quality is controlled.
secondary: Report generic-site-quality coefficients without a separate success gate.
minimum_gate: At least 500 informative pair x species groups, >=250 routes and >=20 species after requiring prior SiteID sampling opportunity.
interpretation: Support favors a species-specific local activity template beyond generic frog-hotspot quality.
It does not distinguish persistent local population, species-specific habitat preference, or individual site fidelity.
No continuous occupancy, same-individual, reproductive-success or causal rainfall claim is authorized.
